objective: Test whether explicitly lossy sparse-tail peeling supplies a genuine Qwen-specific rate-distortion advantage large enough to justify a finite residual codec, with read-valid search retention, finite-only decisions, parent-issued one-use child provenance, executable runtime memory closure, optimistic kill, numerical-boundary, matched-control, support-angle, rate, and read contracts.

source_scope.forbidden: all frozen production, holdout, confirmation, quarantine, blind_protocol_v2/unblinded, and sealed payload containers

families.name: coordinate
families.ordering: stable descending absolute value then canonical flat ordinal

families.name: block16
families.ordering: stable descending contiguous-flat-block energy then block ordinal

families.name: block64
families.ordering: stable descending contiguous-flat-block energy then block ordinal

mask_grid.support_code: fixed-length enumerative rank with ceil(log2 binomial(number_of_units,selected_units)) bits, then byte padding
mask_grid.tail_symbols: fixed log2(K) bits per selected scalar in canonical support order, then byte padding

tail_reconstruction.optimistic_gate: deterministic source-fitted scalar Lloyd centroids are revealed free; support, symbols, descriptors, framing, and residual directories remain charged
tail_reconstruction.finite_tail_row: each centroid is rounded to IEEE FP16, serialized literally at 16 bits, and scored with the rounded centroid
tail_reconstruction.stronger_zero_error_envelope: selected scalars are reconstructed with zero error while support and K-ary symbols remain charged; this is deliberately non-materializable and may only prevent a kill, never promote

bulk_oracle.raw: one ideal Gaussian RD component per unpeeled matrix
bulk_oracle.support_xklt: for a uniform mask profile, partition each expert's Up/Down pair by the three nonempty known-bulk support patterns and diagonalize each two-role Gram block
bulk_oracle.xklt_angle_charge: charge exactly one serialized FP16 angle for each expert with any live retained component whose name contains .both_axis_; retained eigenvalue rank does not waive the angle
bulk_oracle.allocation: one panel-wide integer-bit reverse waterfill over every live bulk component after all tail and framing charges; tail and bulk SSE are added once
bulk_oracle.favorability: ideal Gaussian components omit finite-vector shaping and implementation loss

search.raw: deterministic coordinate descent over all per-matrix profile choices, seeded only by read-valid best-uniform and read-valid zero-tail choices, with every eligible coordinate trial evaluated and ranking/filtering inside the strict <2x set, exactly four maximum full passes
search.support_xklt: complete uniform profile grid with separate global diagnostics and a retained winner selected only inside the strict <2x set
search.read_valid_retention: for every rate/mode/geometry, an invalid global minimum-F row can never erase an evaluated read-valid row; every retained calibration/decision row is explicitly revalidated below 2x

matched_controls.rng: CuPy default_rng with SHA-256-derived 64-bit seeds; exact runtime vector hashes must match the independently audited runtime receipt
matched_controls.construction: independent float32 normal samples RNE-rounded to BF16, then a positive FP32 lookup-table affine transform
matched_controls.observed_moments: mean and population variance after the exact FP32 lookup-table affine are reduced in float64 using the independently calibrated runtime semantics
matched_controls.fail_closed: every target, affine parameter, observed moment, error, and tolerance must be finite; target/pre-affine variance and scale must be strictly positive; each absolute error must not exceed its tolerance
matched_controls.reporting: record every cell's absolute and normalized mean/variance mismatch and panel maxima

decision.finite_only: every individual absolute/calibrated/control score, every aggregate/standard deviation/joint score, every selection key, and every boundary distance must be finite before selection or status; NaN and both infinities fail closed regardless of operand order
decision.read_valid: both maximum cold logical and maximum cold page amplification are strictly below 2.0
decision.optimistic_m: maximum joint_score among read-valid free_lloyd and zero_tail_error rows
decision.finite_best: deterministically selected maximum joint_score among read-valid finite_fp16 rows
decision.finite_residual_codec_warranted_only_if: finite_best has both s_absolute and s_calibrated at least 0.16096404744368115 and no numeric-boundary hold applies
decision.EARLY_KILL_FAR_SHORT: optimistic_m < 0.14096404744368115 and no numeric-boundary hold applies
decision.HOLD_OPTIMISTIC_NEAR_BOUNDARY: 0.14096404744368115 <= optimistic_m < 0.16096404744368115 and no numeric-boundary hold applies
decision.OPTIMISTIC_SURVIVOR: optimistic_m >= 0.16096404744368115, no finite promotion, and no numeric-boundary hold applies
decision.HOLD_NUMERIC_BOUNDARY: if optimistic_m or either absolute/calibrated score of finite_best is within or equal to 0.0001 bpw of either 0.14096404744368115 or 0.16096404744368115; this status can neither kill nor promote
decision.consistency: fail closed if a finite joint score exceeds optimistic_m beyond 1e-12 bpw, or if finite promotion coexists with optimistic_m below target
decision.no_gain_addition: never add this tail gain to a prior architecture; all reported tail and bulk distortion uses one same-rate allocation

serialization.expert_frames: all non-common bytes remain inside the owning expert frame; each frame ends on a byte boundary
serialization.container: whole-byte capacity floor(R*N/8); unused closure bytes are an explicit trailer
serialization.page_read: exact 4096-byte pages intersecting the common prefix or the contiguous expert frame

runtime_release.phase_1: independently source-audit this immutable package without CuPy, CUDA, GPU, or payload access
runtime_release.phase_2: only after phase-1 PASS, separately authorize one source-free runtime_calibrate execution on the pinned RTX5090 runtime; it creates a receipt outside the stage
runtime_release.phase_3: independently audit and seal that runtime receipt
runtime_release.phase_4: a separately approved one-shot production authorization must bind exact package manifest, source audit, runtime receipt, runtime audit, source, output action/path, raw launcher, interpreter, environment, mountinfo, and filesystem identities
runtime_release.production_gate: stdlib-only preflight authenticates its manifested bytes, copies them into a fully sealed memfd, descriptor-reexecutes those immutable bytes, freezes exact independent PASS schemas/statuses, retains the authenticated output-parent dirfd, and spawns the stdlib-only oracle bootstrap over one inherited Unix SOCK_SEQPACKET capability; the capability binds SO_PEERCRED parent/child PIDs, sealed-preflight and output-parent descriptor identities, nonce, manifest/authorization/bootstrap/core hashes, one record then EOF, and one acknowledgement; only that child descriptor-executes the scientific core
runtime_release.direct_entry_firewall: direct scientific-core execution fails before NumPy import; direct oracle-bootstrap execution fails without the live one-use inherited capability; the authorization names only preflight_launch.py
runtime_release.no_self_trust: a runtime receipt authored by runtime_calibrate is not launch authority until an external independent audit and later production authorization bind it

path_and_output_release.entrypoint: audit/calibration/preflight and the child bootstrap validate raw sys.argv[0] as absolute, lexically canonical, symlink-free, exact __file__ identity before third-party import; the scientific core has a top-of-file context firewall before NumPy and cannot be a direct entrypoint
path_and_output_release.stage_closure: exact unique cardinality and exact regular non-symlink member set; added files, directories, devices, duplicate rows, and JSON duplicate keys fail
path_and_output_release.disjointness: stage, source, and the existing parent of the create-new run root must be pairwise disjoint in both ancestry directions; authorization/runtime evidence and their parents cannot nest in or contain any protected root
path_and_output_release.output: authorization binds action CREATE_NEW_RUN_ROOT_AND_RESULT_JSON; preflight retains the authenticated output-parent dirfd, and after the gate every absence check, run-root/result creation, temporary write, fsync, rename, and parent fsync is descriptor-relative with O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW and no output pathname reopen
path_and_output_release.mounts: authorization binds exact /proc/self/mountinfo SHA-256, mount IDs, st_dev/st_ino identities, and rejects nested mount transitions below protected roots
path_and_output_release.claim_limit: descriptor execution/reads and exact mount receipt close cooperative pathname aliasing; no claim is made against a privileged process changing mounts or directories after authorization

claim_boundary: This bounded oracle tests stable coordinate and contiguous block-16/block-64 masks with scalar tail reconstruction on auxiliary Up/Down matrices. It is not a converse for learned semantic masks, vector tail codebooks, Gate matrices, arbitrary blocks, or a finite bulk codec. A source-only seal, runtime receipt, or optimistic survivor is not a compression result or production authorization.
